## Open targets

### Necessary relational foundation of scientific inquiry

Target: test whether the full proposed core is indispensable across the stated scientific scope, assessing from independent achievements and actual relationships within one unfolding which commitments are necessary and which condition particular descriptions.

**Next:** Use the declared questions to compare a warranted scientific claim, a carefully investigated failure and systematic insulation from adverse evidence, testing the demarcation assessment; separately, pair actual initial evidence with commands for the timed bound.

`open` · [record](theories/becoming/results/records/scientific-inquiry-foundation.md) · [canonical source](theories/becoming/history/SCIENTIFIC-PHILOSOPHY.md)

### Theory of Becoming: full foundational target

Target: the deductive necessity of Becoming as a whole, with no added substantive axiom: formally, every central law over every law of exchange; philosophically, its determinations as moments of one unfolding; generation, persistence, degeneration, dissolution, life, evolution, evaluation within it.

**Next:** Formal part: every central law of the spine (K1) stated over every law of exchange, as premises-read-off-the-exchange and premises-that-are-states-of-the-law do for the World premises, the families joined by definition (worlds-are-runs). Philosophical part: the whole relationally constituted, not only consistently stated.

`open` · [record](theories/becoming/results/records/theory-of-becoming-foundation.md) · [canonical source](theories/becoming/history/BECOMING-FOUNDATION.md)

### Whether a universal practical warrant exists

Question: whether practical reasons have a warrant binding every possible mind, with zero substantive premises. It stays open, and the ethics, life's stance, does not wait on it.

**Next:** An argument either way: a warrant binding every possible mind that, where it grounds the condition, says where it comes from beyond logic alone and the represented dynamics alone; or a showing that none exists for a stated class of minds. The practical judgment the ethics for life needs is the work of the goal of practical judgment for life, and does not wait on this question.

`open` · [record](theories/becoming/results/records/universal-practical-warrant.md) · [canonical source](theories/becoming/history/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md)

### Core as the root of wisdom target

Target: establish that the core’s common relations are indispensable across all wisdom under discussion, and thereby the foundational status of the whole core.

**Next:** Complete the substantive necessity of the whole core for independently specified wisdom: align content, grounds, uptake and claimed activity, explain why the selected claims and relations preserve the same achievement, and compare faithful alternatives.

`open` · [record](theories/becoming/results/records/wisdom-root.md) · [canonical source](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md)

## Beyond the readings

The readings are decided by argument and can be revised by a better one. What waits on the author is his authorizations and releases: the goal scopes and their states, the licence, pushing to the public remote, who is sent what, and money or machine time for runs. The body of the opening and the curated generativity chain began as the author's text and are revised on argument, the opening's revisions named under its heading and the chain's in its maintenance record. The choice of results featured on the home page is open to revision on argument.
